note: Oman: the other GCC states' citizens move freely; New Zealanders stay 90 days without a visa, Belarus, Brunei, Kazakhstan, Russia and Türkiye 30, and the long list 14 days (with a hotel booking, insurance, a return ticket and funds); a longer stay is an e-Visa online. Nationals of the countries on the substitute list (India, Egypt, Mexico and others) may enter for 14 days only holding certain third-country visas or a GCC residence (not modelled); everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Royal Oman Police rules.
